title: The Terminal of the Rust Belt Revisited
author: Wendell Delacroix
blurb: Rosalind Okonkwo, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
